arStrings.szText: {c_important}The Hunter{/c} restores {c_number}[SF_21*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Health per strike.

{c_important}The Hunter{/c} overfills your {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} by {c_number}{SF_13}{/c} stacks. Killing enemies while with it active has a {c_number}[{SF_16}*100|%|]{/c} chance to instantly reset its Cooldown. This chance is halved after each consecutive reset.

{c_important}The Hunter{/c} strikes an additional {c_number}[SF_25]{/c} times and consumes all of your {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} to deal {c_number}[{SF_33}*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage per {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c}.

{c_important}The Hunter{/c} is also a {c_important}Gorilla{/c} Skill. 

The Gorilla Spirit knocks enemies towards {c_important}The Hunter's{/c} landing spot, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_DAMAGE}{/c} Physical damage and Knocking Down enemies on landing for {c_number}{SF_27}{/c} seconds. Each enemy you damage with {c_important}The Hunter{/c} grants {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}, which can overfill your {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} by {c_number}{SF_24}{/c} stacks.
